company.name: Anaplan
company.shortDescription: Anaplan is a business planning software company that develops a cloud platform for decision-making with connected planning modeling.
company.description: Anaplan is driving a new age of connected planning. Large and fast-growing organizations use Anaplan’s cloud platform in every business function to make better-informed plans and decisions and drive faster, more effective planning processes. Anaplan also provides support, training, and planning transformation advisory services. Anaplan is a privately held company based in San Francisco with 16 offices and over 150 expert partners worldwide.

aiResearchSummary.text: Anaplan is researching data driven business planning tools. Application configurator using a baseline model describes generating new applications from baseline planning models for consistent model configuration. Synchronized scrolling of multiple grids across multi-dimensional data improves exploration of complex planning grids. Systems and methods for forecasting warm start items, merging datasets, and dimensional reduction of categorical data enhance forecasting, data integration, and time series analysis.
